🧭 User Journey Map#

Session Flow (The “Happy Path”)#

graph TD
    Start(App Launch) --> Login{Auth Check}
    Login -- New User --> Tutorial[Tutorial Mission]
    Login -- Returning --> MainMenu[Main Menu]
    Tutorial --> MainMenu
    
    MainMenu --> Prep[Preparation Phase]
    Prep -->|Select Loadout| LoadoutUI
    LoadoutUI -->|Ready| Matchmaking
    
    Matchmaking --> Loading{Loading Level}
    Loading --> Spawn[In-Raid Gameplay]
    
    Spawn -->|Death| DefeatScreen
    Spawn -->|Extraction| VictoryScreen
    
    DefeatScreen --> Summary[After Action Report]
    VictoryScreen --> Summary
    
    Summary --> MainMenu

📱 Key Screen Wireframes#

1. Main Menu (Hub)#

Goal: Quick access to “Play” while showing progression.

Visual Style & Art Guidelines#

← Back to Index | UX Flows ←

🎨 Visual Identity#

Style: Grounded Neo-Industrial Era: Post-Collapse (Near Future 2035)

Design Philosophy#

  • Decay with Memory: Every rusted panel was once new. Every ruin was a home. The world is overgrown, not just dirty.
  • Tactical Clarity: Gameplay elements (cover, loot, enemies) must be instantly readable against the chaotic background.
  • Functional Fashion: Gear looks practical. No glowing magical armor. Duct tape, zip ties, and worn metal.
